game.name: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North - Legacy Edition

items.text: Patch Overview
Steadier co-op: fewer crashes and freezes when joining, loading in, and when heading back to towns
Clearer roads north: quest tracking fixes and cleared progression blockers keep your journey moving
Headshots are back: ranged attacks land true on goblins, Uruk-hai, and more
Fallen heroes return: back in the fight with at least 2 health and power potions and 20 arrows or bolts
Companion, visual, and audio polish across Middle-earth
Bug Fixes
Improved co-op stability, with fixes for crashes during matchmaking, on loading screens, and when returning to hubs like Bree and Fornost.
Fixed players joining a host getting stuck on the map selection.
Fixed a freeze that could occur when another player with a slow connection joined during a loading screen.
Fixed a progression blocker in Fornost where a goblin could be launched somewhere out of reach.
Blocked off an area in the Grey Mountains where heroes could be knocked out of bounds.
Fixed when Scroll 7 would not count toward the "Cult of the Lidless Eye" side quest.
The Urgost introductory cutscene no longer skips when loading the checkpoint.
Mission summary stats are now kept when returning to town mid-mission.
The War-Mechanist Achievement/Trophy now counts kills across your whole fellowship instead of per character.
Headshot hitboxes have been restored on goblins, Uruk-hai, and other enemies throughout the game.
Health potions now fill the health bar steadily, as intended.
Allies no longer get stuck after opening a Secret Stash, and can now be called to a stash from farther away.
Luin now keeps moving as intended after loading a save.
The revive prompt no longer appears when another player is already reviving a fallen hero.
Fixed some equipment getting lost when using a respec token.
Map fragments are no longer wasted when used from an inactive character's inventory.
Fixed distorted audio that could play when finishing an enemy with a critical strike.
Undead no longer T-pose during a Barrow-Downs cutscene.
Textures in Osgiliath, the Coldfells, and Urgost's Lair no longer vanish when viewed from certain angles.
Fixed severe stretching on some character models.
Item description panels no longer disappear when equipping certain weapons during combat.
Item notifications now show the correct amount when sending the same item multiple times.
Removed an inaccurate loading screen tip.
Faster EULA scrolling with a controller.
Smoother mouse wheel scrolling in settings menus.
Added Steam controller glyphs for Steam and Steam Deck.
PATCH 1 IS NOW LIVE

The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition Patch 1 resolves several critical bugs, including equipment and gear loss issues, a progression blocker in Fornost, and general stability improvements.
Fixed a multiplayer progression blocker where a certain gate on Fornost would fail to release progression critical enemies when the party respawns.
Fixed issues with cinematics aborting and asset loading when characters are swapped at checkpoints in multiplayer.
Optimized loading so that characters stats no longer unnecessarily refresh upon loading a save.
Added safety checks during loading to prevent equipment with temporarily mismatched stats from being accidentally unequipped or deleted.
Corrected item spawning logic to prevent items from accumulating in large piles at specific locations on each level.
Fixed several instances where the visual state of characters’ gear would be desynced for a Host and Client in Multiplayer games.
Now Steam Deck Verified
PC / Storefront Extras: Fixed a borderless window mode bug where pending resolution changes would fail to revert to the previous resolution when it expired.
